{{Current events|year=2025|month=12|day=2|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza hostage crisis]]
***Hamas returns the remains of an unidentified person, possibly a hostage, to [[Israel]]i authorities to be examined by [[forensics]] experts. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/israel-receives-remains-of-possible-hostage-and-plans-to-reopen-gaza-crossing-into-egypt (PBS)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
** [[2025 Bannu ambush]]
***A government administrator, two of his guards and a passerby are killed in an [[ambush]] against a vehicle in [[Bannu]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-gunmen-killed-government-administrator-northwest-afghanistan-d59593ed50a51102bd98b4e59f7b3c44 (AP)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Winter (Fabergé egg)|Winter Egg]], one of the few [[Fabergé egg]]s remaining in private hands, sells at [[Christie's]] in [[London]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], for [[British pound|£]]22.9 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]30.2 million), setting a new auction record for a work by the [[House of Fabergé]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/12/02/style/faberge-winter-egg-auction-sold (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Indonesia–Netherlands relations]]
**[[Indonesia]] and the [[Netherlands]] agree to repatriate two elderly [[Dutch nationality law|Dutch nationals]] convicted of [[Organised crime in Indonesia|drug trafficking]], including one on [[Capital punishment in Indonesia|death row]], on humanitarian grounds, following a request from [[King of the Netherlands|Dutch king]] [[Willem-Alexander of the Netherlands|Willem-Alexander]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-dutch-sign-deal-repatriate-two-convicts-one-death-row-2025-12-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[Deportation in the second Trump administration]]
**[[Venezuela]] approves the [[United States]]'s request to resume [[Deportation from the United States|deportation]] flights, reversing a brief suspension imposed following [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s declaration that Venezuelan [[airspace]] was "closed". [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/world/2025/12/02/venezuela-reauthorizes-deportation-flights-from-us-ministry- (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Samaritan's Purse Cessna 208 hijacking]]
**A [[Cessna 208 Caravan]] operated by [[Samaritan's Purse]] to distribute humanitarian aid to [[Maiwut County]] is hijacked in [[Juba]] by a gunman who tried to divert the plane to [[Chad]], but is apprehended after landing to refuel in [[Wau, South Sudan|Wau]], South Sudan. [https://apnews.com/article/south-sudan-aid-plane-hijacked-gunman-d436a7cb44f3cfb03b2b85710c6f9ea6 (AP)]
*[[Colombia]]n authorities detain 17 children and nine adults belonging to the [[Jewish fundamentalism|fundamentalist]] [[Jewish]] [[cult]] [[Lev Tahor]], citing concerns about the safety of the children in the group. Five of the children had [[United States|American]] and [[Guatemala]]n passports, and all 26 members were flown to [[New York City|New York]] to await investigations into their welfare. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-ultra-orthodox-jewish-sect-lev-tahor-45392d6b12f2b8223152f2cb231a7a72 (AP)]
*Former [[European Union]] [[High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy|foreign and security policy chief]] [[Federica Mogherini]] and two others are arrested in [[Belgium]] amid a [[Budget accountability in the European Union|fraud]] investigation. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/02/former-eu-top-diplomat-federica-mogherini-arrest-fraud-investigation (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Tunisia]]n police arrest former [[Human rights in Tunisia|human rights]] minister [[Ayachi Hammami]] to enforce a five-year prison sentence for a [[Sedition|state-security conspiracy]] conviction issued amid recent [[appellate court]] rulings that imposed long jail terms on [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] figures. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisia-arrests-prominent-opposition-figure-hammami-enforce-5-year-jail-term-2025-12-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état]], [[2025 Guinea-Bissau general election]]
**The [[Guinea-Bissau|Bissau-Guinean]] [[Elections in Guinea-Bissau|electoral commission]] announces that it is unable to release election results after armed men destroyed nearly all election tally sheets during the coup. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20251202-guinea-bissau-electoral-commission-says-armed-men-destroyed-election-ballots (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2025 Saint Lucian general election]]
**Incumbent [[Saint Lucia]]n [[Prime Minister of Saint Lucia|prime minister]] [[Philip J. Pierre]] wins a second term in office while his party, the [[Saint Lucia Labour Party]], wins 14 of the 15 seats in [[Parliament of Saint Lucia|Parliament]] against the opposition [[United Workers Party (Saint Lucia)|United Workers Party]]. [https://apnews.com/article/st-lucia-election-philip-pierre-56d56031ade620596291ad9d1992ed4e (AP)]
*[[2026 Haitian general election]]
**The [[Transitional Presidential Council]] of [[Haiti]] announces that presidential and legislative elections will be held in August 2026. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20251202-haiti-sets-august-2026-elections (AFP via France 24)]
*The [[Bulgaria]]n [[National Assembly (Bulgaria)|parliament]] withdraws its draft 2026 [[Government budget|budget]], originally prepared for [[Bulgaria and the euro|the adoption]] of the [[euro]], following nationwide protests against proposed [[Taxation in Bulgaria|tax]] increases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/bulgarias-government-withdraws-2026-draft-budget-after-protests-2025-12-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nigeria]]n [[President of Nigeria|president]] [[Bola Tinubu]] appoints retired [[Nigerian Army|army]] general [[Christopher Gwabin Musa]] as [[Defence Minister of Nigeria|defence minister]], following [[Mohammed Badaru Abubakar]]'s resignation amid a nationwide [[State of emergency|security emergency]]. [https://www.theafricareport.com/400924/nigeria-names-former-top-general-christopher-musa-as-defence-minister/ (AFP via ''The Africa Report'')]
